title: I WISH IT HAD A LONGER SPOUT.
text: I WISH IT HAD A LONGER SPOUT.. I had gotten a plastic dish soap holder that started leaking so I decided to get a glass one so I wouldn't have to worry about leaks. I like this one but the spout isn't as long as I would have liked.

product_metadata.title: ARKTEK Glass Soap Dispenser - Clear Dish for Kitchen, Refillable Liquid Hand with Rust Proof Stainless Steel Pump Bathroom, Countertop (17 Ounce/ 500 ML)
features: 🐬 GLASS SOAP DISPENSER WITH PUMP - The ARKTEK Soap Dispenser is crafted from high-quality, thick glass that is highly durable and not easily broken. The anti-rust stainless steel pump is sturdy and easy to use due to the weight of the glass.

🐬 NO LEAKS, NO DRIPPING - The stainless steel pump head of our soap dispenser features leak-proof gaskets, ensuring that there are no leaks or drips, so you don't have to worry about liquid soap spilling due to accidental bumps.

🐬 ELEGANT & STYLISH ART - The clear Boston round bottle design of the ARKTEK Soap Dispenser not only allows you to easily see the remaining contents but also adds an elegant and stylish touch to your home decor. It also makes for a perfect gift.

🐬 VERSATILE SOAP DISPENSER - The Clear Glass Soap Dispenser is a multi-functional solution that can be used for hand soap, dish soap, lotion, and more. Whether you need a kitchen soap dispenser or a stylish addition to your bathroom decor, this dispenser is the perfect choice.
🐬 SIZE & CAPACITY - ARKTEK Soap Dispenser is 7.87 inches in height and 3.0 inches in outer diameter, with a capacity of 17 ounces of liquid.
